title: The Solo Table for One
description: A woman overcomes the anxiety of dining alone at a busy restaurant and enjoys her own company.
character_reference: a woman with sleek black bob hair and striking dark eyes wearing a sleek charcoal blazer over a simple black top

scenes.narration: The host asked how many in her party, and the words felt terrifying to say aloud in a crowded bistro: just one, please.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of a woman standing near a restaurant host stand with soft warm pendant lights glowing overhead

scenes.narration: She felt every eye in the room turn toward her, assuming everyone was secretly pitying the lone woman eating dinner by herself.
scenes.visual: POV shot looking down at a crisp linen menu held by hands with neat nude nail polish in a dimly lit dining room

scenes.narration: The immediate impulse was to pull out her phone, scroll mindlessly through feeds, and hide behind a glowing screen.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a smartphone screen casting blue light on fingers resting on a dark restaurant table

scenes.narration: Instead, she locked the phone, placed it face down, and looked around at the bustling tables, the chefs, the amber lights.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a hand placing a smartphone face down on a polished wooden table next to silverware

scenes.narration: She ordered the appetizer she actually wanted without sharing, and savored every single bite without rushing.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a small artisanal plate of food with warm overhead spotlighting and rich color contrast

scenes.narration: Nobody was staring at her; everyone was busy living their own lives. The awkwardness dissolved into quiet enjoyment.
scenes.visual: Profile shot of a woman smiling gently while holding a glass of red wine in a sophisticated restaurant setting

scenes.narration: Enjoying your own company is a superpower that nobody can ever take away from you.
scenes.visual: Close-up of calm, confident eyes looking toward a warm ambient light source with a gentle smile

scenes.narration: Treat yourself with kindness today. Follow along for more empowering stories.
scenes.visual: An empty wine glass and folded linen napkin resting on a warm wooden table bathed in soft restaurant lighting
